ios.desc:
A simple tool for musicians that helps you find all of the right notes in the right key. Use the built-in synth sounds or send MIDI output to hardware synths or your DAW.

Helps you answer:
* What notes are in this key?
* What keys have these notes?
* What chords are in this key?

Features:
* Three built-in synth presets (mallets, horns, and a fuzzy synth)
* MIDI out over USB or network
* Supports 30+ scales including diatonic, pentatonic, blues, bebop, and more!
* Filter notes to a selected key/scale
* Find keys with selected notes
* Chord pads for easy chord playing
* Roman numeral analysis

quotes.text:
This was kinda cool once I got it working! It reminds me of the terminal learn to type games.

I made an app to help learn chords and keys too: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bloopkeys/id6689494178

Mine doesn't require MIDI (although it supports MIDI out as an option), but I can see why you went with that for yours.

Some notes/thoughts:
1. It didn't work on my iPhone (either with Firefox or Safari). 
2. A helpful sentence or two would be useful. For example, it wasn't obvious that what you were looking for was midi in and not midi out.
3. Ignore the folks on here talking about monetization (it won't compete with something like Melodics). You made a fun little thing and that's great.
quotes.story_title: Show HN: A simple web game to help learn chords and basic progressions
